results.title: PISA
results.snippet: This dashboard presents key findings from the OECD Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA). It brings together data and indicators on student learning outcomes and related themes, allowing users to explore performance trends, compare results across countries, and examine evolving topics such as digital use in schools.

results.title: PISA 2022 Country Notes - OECD
results.snippet: In Moria, mean performance was close to the level observed in 2018 in mathematics, while it was less than the level observed in 2018 in reading and science. Math scores have declined recently, indicating a potential challenge that requires attention from policymakers.

results.title: PISA Dashboard | OECD
results.snippet: This dashboard presents key findings from the OECD Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA). It brings together data and indicators on student learning outcomes and related themes, allowing users to explore performance trends, compare results across countries, and examine evolving topics such as digital use in schools. The dashboard is regularly updated in line with new PISA releases.

results.title: PISA 2022 Results (Volume I) - OECD
results.snippet: This is one of five volumes that present the results of the eighth round of assessment, PISA 2022. Volume I, The State of Learning and Equity in Education, describes students' performance in mathematics, reading and science; examines gender differences in performance; and investigates how performance relates to students' socio-economic status and immigrant background.
